nodes.description: Owned.owner: privileged address controlling onlyOwner functions
Owned.newOwner: pending owner set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership
CHFT.balances: mapping(address => uint) token balances mutated by transfer/transferFrom
CHFT.allowed: nested allowance mapping written by approve/approveAndCall, spent by transferFrom
CHFT._totalSupply: fixed total token supply set in constructor
CHFT.symbol token ticker metadata
CHFT.name token display name metadata
CHFT.decimals token precision metadata
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): overflow-checked addition
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): underflow-checked subtraction
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): overflow-checked multiplication
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): division with zero check
Owned constructor: assigns owner from msg.sender
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: stages newOwner
Owned.acceptOwnership(): verifies msg.sender == newOwner and rotates owner
CHFT constructor: sets metadata, total supply and pre-mints to a fixed address
CHFT.totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply minus balances of address(0)
CHFT.balanceOf(address tokenOwner): reads balances mapping
CHFT.transfer(address to, uint tokens): moves tokens from msg.sender
CHFT.approve(address spender, uint tokens): writes allowance for msg.sender
CHFT.transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): moves allowance-backed tokens
CHFT.allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): reads allowed mapping
CHFT.approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then invokes spender callback
CHFT fallback payable function: always reverts, rejects ETH
CHFT.transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens) onlyOwner: sweeps arbitrary ERC20
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authentication, ownership checks and balance keys
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) to an attacker-supplied contract before state is finalized
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an attacker-supplied token contract
Raw subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] in totalSupply() outside SafeMath

approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callback
onlyOwner authorizes transferAnyERC20Token by comparing msg.sender to owner
transfer mutates balances[msg.sender] and balances[to]
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender
approve writes the allowed allowance mapping
transferFrom mutates balances[from] and balances[to]
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender]
transferFrom calls safeSub for balance and allowance updates

malicious ERC20 target can re-enter token transfer functions during the external call
transferOwnership stages the pending owner in newOwner
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter only exists to key the balances write inside transfer
Amount parameter only exists to drive safeSub/safeAdd inside transfer
Debit-account parameter is scoped entirely to transferFrom balance bookkeeping
Credit-account parameter is scoped entirely to transferFrom balance bookkeeping
Amount parameter is only used for balance and allowance subtraction inside transferFrom
Spender parameter is only the key of the allowed mapping write in approve
Amount parameter is only the value stored by approve
Spender parameter directly determines the external callback target invoked by approveAndCall
Amount parameter is only the allowance value stored before the callback
Opaque payload is forwarded unchanged into the external receiveApproval call
Token address parameter directly selects the external contract that is called
Amount parameter is the value forwarded in the external ERC20 transfer call
